item.title: NordProtect rolls out expanded monitoring features for identity theft detection
item.description: NordProtect, an identity theft protection service from Nord Security, has expanded its monitoring features to give users earlier notice of potential fraudulent activity. The changes add extended credit monitoring, loan tracking, and financial account alerts, with the goal of helping users respond before financial damage occurs. item.title: EaseUS adds fragmented file recovery tech to Data Recovery Wizard
item.description: Chinese software developer EaseUS has announced a new version of its data recovery software that fixes on a long standing problem with fragmented files on heavily used storage devices. EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard 20.1.0 gains a new recovery engine that can improve results on USB drives, SD cards, and external hard drives that have seen years of repeated use.
